intent: Cluster test (Expensify/Expensify#661688) verifying a command that would issue an HTTPS request on the serialized blockingCommit thread is refused rather than allowed to stall that thread, whether detected before or during peek's wait.

objects.name: HTTPSBlockingCommitTest::setup/teardown
objects.role: own the BedrockClusterTester and lower/restore MaxConflictRetries so contention reliably reaches worker 0

objects.name: HTTPSBlockingCommitTest::runAndVerifyRefusals
objects.role: fires many concurrent mutually-conflicting commands across all nodes, checks every one responds with at least one refusal

objects.name: HTTPSBlockingCommitTest::testRefusedViaPreCheck
objects.role: refusal via the worker loop's pre-check

objects.name: HTTPSBlockingCommitTest::testRefusedViaPeekThrow
objects.role: refusal via the throw path inside peek's HTTPS wait
